evals.prompt:
Create the catalog descriptor for this repository:

- Repository: acme/ledger-sync (https://github.com/acme/ledger-sync)
- Evidence found in the source: a Python FastAPI HTTP service that reads files from one storage bucket and writes JSON lines to another; it is deployed to production; the project documentation assigns ownership to the platform-team group.
- The repository contains no API specification files.

The entity must be named ledger-sync with type service, lifecycle production, and owner referencing the platform-team group. Ground every field in the evidence only; omit any field the evidence does not support (no system, tags, links, or dependencies). Answer with only one fenced yaml block containing the final catalog-info.yaml.
evals.expected_output: One catalog-info.yaml document: a Component named ledger-sync with spec.type service, spec.lifecycle production, and spec.owner referencing the platform-team group, and no fields beyond the supplied evidence.
assertions: The bundled check-descriptors.mjs passes the generated descriptor
No unsupported fields appear: system, tags, links, dependencies, providesApis

evals.prompt:
Generate the mkdocs.yml for this documented repository:

- Entity name: inventory-notifier (the mkdocs site_name must be exactly this).
- The docs/ directory contains these pages: index.md, usage.md.
- TechDocs builds this site, so plugins must include techdocs-core.
- Set repo_url to https://github.com/acme/inventory-notifier.

Answer with only one fenced yaml block containing the final mkdocs.yml.
evals.expected_output: One mkdocs.yml for inventory-notifier: site_name inventory-notifier, the techdocs-core plugin, a nav that resolves against the real docs/ tree, and repo_url set to https://github.com/acme/inventory-notifier.
assertions: The bundled check-descriptors.mjs passes the assembled entity
The bundled check-techdocs.mjs passes the assembled site
site_name matches the entity name inventory-notifier
every nav page resolves against the actual docs/ directory
